name: dsh-swarm-workflow
description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: injects the global execution policy into the Coordinator, a scoped view of it plus the role methods into every delegated lane, and registers the swarm-engineering skill. The policy is the user's own text, adapted to this host - every deliberate adaptation is recorded in docs/host-adaptation.md, every host-specific fact lives in runtime-note.md, and the craft guidance for the lanes lives in skills/swarm-engineering/, with the language pieces for Python, Java, Go, TypeScript and Rust.
